title: A normalized lazy predictor gives expected amplitude control
statement: At each queried prefix draw N next-bit samples,store q_N(1|y)=(K+1)/(N+2),and reuse it within the replicate. Conceptually preassign independent batches on all prefixes,then reveal only visited prefixes;no exponential tree is generated. E D(p||q_N)<=m log[(N+2)/(N+1)]<=m/(N+1),hence E||sqrt(q_N)e^{i theta}-sqrt(p)e^{i theta}||²<=same. Joint batch-TV and stored-branch rounding are charged. Output selection uses fresh independent randomness;independent correction replicates use fresh trees. Resampling each amplitude,sharing predictor/output randomness or reusing a tree across nominal independent replicates invalidates this proof. Probabilities do not reveal unknown phases;impossible-prefix calls must terminate. Adar conditional simulation/lazy-cache ancestry is retained.
